thing-thakhek-loop: Ride Khammouane’s classic motorbike loop through caves, karst roads, reservoirs and Kong Lor.
thing-kong-lor-cave: Cross a limestone mountain by longtail boat through Kong Lor’s vast underground river.
thing-xe-bang-fai-cave: A remote river-cave expedition through vast limestone chambers in Hin Nam No.
thing-tham-nang-aen-cave: Explore huge lit limestone chambers near Thakhek, with an optional underground boat ride.
thing-tham-xiang-liap-cave: A natural river cave with a huge entrance, flowing water and seasonal adventure.
thing-tham-chang-elephant-cave: A compact Buddhist cave shrine with an elephant-shaped rock formation and valley views.
thing-tham-pha-buddha-cave: A sacred cave near Thakhek sheltering 229 bronze Buddha images.
thing-tha-falang: A relaxed riverside stop for shade, clear water and swimming when conditions allow.
thing-khoun-kong-leng: An emerald karst spring north of Thakhek, surrounded by limestone and forest.
thing-thalang-nam-theun-reservoir: A classic Loop overnight beside the Nam Theun 2 reservoir and drowned-tree landscape.
thing-pha-inh-cave: A quiet sacred cave with a Buddhist shrine and naturally lit underground pool.
thing-cool-springs-loop: Cold turquoise spring water makes this an easy cooling stop on Loop Day 2.
thing-dragon-cave: A roadside cave near Lak Sao combining low passages, a large chamber and viewpoint.
thing-sandstone-buddhas: Roadside Buddha carvings cut directly into sandstone cliffs along Route 1E.
thing-phou-pha-marn-viewpoint: A dramatic Route 8 viewpoint over Khammouane’s limestone forest and karst towers.
thing-old-thakhek-mekong: Walk old shophouse streets, the central square and Thakhek’s Mekong riverfront.
thing-sikhottabong-stupa: Khammouane’s sacred riverside stupa, a short cultural trip south of Thakhek.
thing-hin-nam-no-national-park: Remote UNESCO-listed karst wilderness of caves, forest and limestone towers.
